issue.title: proseField rebind: removal blur closes an open LINK band and rebind drops the unresolved-link hint

task_type_fields.impact: A future prose host that rebuilds its input loses an open LINK band (selection, drill stage) on every repaint in real Chromium, and any rebinding host loses the unresolved-link hint until the next keystroke. No shipped host (S1-S15) is affected today.
task_type_fields.repro:
Proposed by bob-cli-om.6 (note #2, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP), triaged by bob-cli-om.land.

Two latent gaps in the proseField controller (bob-plugins `plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/189b-prose-field-controller.js`) for hosts that replace the input element during a repaint:

1. **Removal blur closes an open band.** In Chromium, removing a focused input dispatches `blur`. The controller's `onBlur` (`if (linkOpen) closeBand(false)`) then closes the LINK band before the host can call `handle.rebind({ inputEl, bandHost })`. Selection, field state, and the no-fade-replay rule are lost.
2. **`rebind` does not repaint the unresolved-link hint.** When `bandHost` changes, `ensureHosts()` creates a fresh `hintHost`, but `rebind` only calls `renderLink()`. The `⚠ [[x]] — no such note` hint disappears until the next input event.

Repro (unit level): use the fake DOM in `scripts/test-ledger-tools-intention-card-prose-field.cjs` (`blurOnRemoval = true`) without the S14 guard (`intentionCardEditorProseGuardBlur` in ledger-tools `297cd`). Open the band, repaint, and the band is closed. For (2), type a complete `[[missing]]`, wait for the 250 ms hint, rebind with a new band host, and the hint slot is empty.

Shipped hosts are not affected today: S14 Intention Card guards the blur in ledger-tools; S15 Record Card keeps its live input and uses rebind only as a fallback; S6 successor reason commits on blur anyway; S10 detaches and re-attaches per focus, and a fresh attach recomputes the hint. Fix it in the controller so any future element-replacing host is safe without copying S14's guard. Suggested approach: on blur, defer the close to the next tick and skip it when the handle was rebound to a focused input; in `rebind`, call `renderHint()` (or `scheduleHint()`) after `ensureHosts()`. Keep S14's synchronous "a real blur closes the band" behavior or update its test, and verify in real Chromium (the om.7 note #1 Playwright Chromium + CDP setup).

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-om.6 found that the proseField controller cannot keep its band across element-replacing repaints without a host-side guard; the landing judged it unreachable in shipped hosts, but future hosts will hit it.
